notes.title: MuGen was just updated - new melody types, dark mode and more!
notes.content:
Four new melody types added: Major and Minor Pentatonic, and Minor and Major Blues. Try combining these with different scales and modes for some interesting results. Not every combination will sound good but maybe you will be delightfully surprised.

Other changes:

[list]
[*]When generating more than one song at a time, each new song is randomized with a new seed to make them sound more different
[*]New option added: Darkify! Because sometimes you're just in a darker mood. This will darken the entire song with two whole octaves.
[*]Solo, Play and Export now respects tempo and other settings.
[*]Some bugs that created situations where the program would freeze up have been fixed
[*]A bug where Factory Reset would not work has been fixed
[*]The manual has been updated
[*]Fixed a bug where the bass line would become insanely fast in some situations
[/list]

notes.title: MuGen - The Music Generator was just updated!
notes.content:
New in version 2.4.1

As always, uninstall the old version before installing the new one!

Unleash your creativity!

notes.title: New internal music player and note viewer
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now use the MuGen internal music player to play back generated songs. 
[*] A new Note Viewer will show in real time the notes played in each channel.
[*] You can also click the new 'stop music' button to stop playback at any time.
[*] Added new options for melody direction change and melody note max deviation from root for more melody control
[*] FX notes will now respect current scale and key. 
[*] Fixed bug where the wrong instrument was shown for a channel.
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

notes.title: MuGen - The Music Generator leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]MuGen - The Music Generator has left Early Access![/h1]

[h2]Melody generation is totally revamped![/h2]

We have implemented a new form of melody generation called chord strumming. It works by strumming each chord according to a strumming pattern, much like how you would play a melody on a guitar. 

You can choose if the strumming pattern should be kept throughout the song, change per song part (verse, chorus...) or even change every chord for those experimental, unpredictable melodies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450460/9280fa0c717310a54aad8c86361f83d615f3e3f5.png[/img]

(The checkbox for chord based melody has been removed, and you can now choose between chord based, scale based and chord strumming melodies.)

[h2]Now go and unleash your creativity![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41450460/57e62577742d75189dea7f43e156e605f62925d7.png[/img]

notes.title: We're leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
1.9.6 - We're leaving Early Access!

* Some bugfixes
* Some polish

Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs and come up with suggestions for improvements over the last year! 

Even though the application is now officially released, we are still going to improve it!

In fact a whole new melody creation module that shows a lot of promise is under development! 

Excited to reveal more when the time is right!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.9.5 HOTFIX
notes.content:
Unfortunately, and old bug managed to sneak back into the code with the previous release.
This bug has now been fixed, songs should no longer go out of tune. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: MuGen - The Music Generator was just updated!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW IN 1.5:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Solo parts - listen to individual parts of the generated song
[*] Export part - export individual parts of the generated song
[*] Load/Save custom profiles. Share your profiles with friends and/or with the community!
[*] Language selection - english, italian, french - german on the way

notes.title: MuGen - The Music Generator - major update!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW IN 1.4[/h1]

[h3]UI rehaul edition[/h3]

[b]* Preview play progressions, instruments and drums right in the UI

* Exported tracks now contain part and instrument name

* Unused parts with no notes are not exported

* Removed pause in beginning and end of songs[/b]

Unleash your creativity today!

notes.title: Version 1.3 has many new asked-for features and improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW IN 1.3[/h1]

[list]
[*] A button to show the user manual
[*] Expert settings
[*]  Edit progression library. Add your own progressions or delete the ones you don't want.
[*]  Show instrument names in MIDI tracks and export XML
[*]  Show instrument names in metadata
[*]  Choose channel instruments
[*]  Choose drumset drums
[*]  Modify channel Spread, Bounce, Silence, Rhythm, Dynamics and Merge for even more control over the generated music
[*]  Some settings were moved from normal settings to expert settings: Embellish, Note rest and part silencing
[/list]

Please uninstall the old version before installing the new one!

[h3]Happy composing![/h3]
